stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The money-market-fund guide compares with one named bank (Leumi) and cites that bank's deposit rate, in a page about a general product.","where":"the comparison lines and their source","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Return is not guaranteed and bank deposits aren't insured either, which worries the reader
Real return after costs is unknown: the page gives no typical management fee figure
Money can't be withdrawn the same minute, only on a trading day
The '123 מקור / חושב / הזנה' line at the top is confusing
The paragraph about the 10% foreign-securities rule and the clearing house (המסלקה) loses the reader
The open question about Friday redemptions worries the reader: even the site doesn't know
The 'play with your numbers' calculator is closed, so the reader can't enter their own amount
Tax text is hard to follow: exempt vs. taxable fund, nominal vs. real
Unclear what the small yellow dot on the current-account bar means
'אין תקרה בחוק' repeated in the fee table makes the reader uneasy
Law codes (MF-, TXS-, BANK-) and the rules column mean nothing to the reader
'מונח הקישו להסבר' isn't understood
Unclear whether the reader needs 'הצגת החוקים והכללים' next to each heading
Unclear how many days until the money reaches the current account
The actual time of 'השעה היעודה' isn't stated
Unclear whether the 0.1% distribution fee comes out of the reader's money
No worked example in shekels after fees and tax
No sense of whether such funds have lost money, or how big a drop could be
No guidance on choosing between funds, or whether the reader's own bank's offer is fine
Would drop the 'מה האתר לקח בחשבון' section
Would drop the 'איפה מופיע' column and most of the glossary
Would cut 'מי מציע ומי מפקח' down to one sentence
Would drop the 10% rule / clearing house / Friday paragraph

problems.why: The report never mentions Leumi or a single named bank's deposit rate in the comparison. It only notes Discount in passing as small print, without objecting to a named bank being used.
